title: A shop term nobody has used on a synced record is never sent
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the test organization is connected to a QuickBooks Online sandbox company, and you can sign in to that company in another tab.
  • Make sure the shop's own term A was created today and is held only by one customer, who has no invoice.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps: 1. In QuickBooks, open the Terms list (Settings, All lists, Terms).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • There is no term A.
